system.name: HardPT
system.one_liner: Few-shot prompt-tuning framework that sorts samples into easy, hard and misleading with an RL agent and trains on hard samples with an adaptive contrastive loss.

content.variant_note: two lettered stages stacked: (a) review sentences stratified into EASY, HARD, MISLEADING; (b) prompt-based training on EASY and HARD with positive and negative sample rows
content.argues: Samples differ in value: sorting them into easy, hard and misleading lets prompt-tuning train on hard samples, with positive and negative samples added, while leaving misleading ones out.
content.subject: Review sentences stratified into easy, hard, misleading; then templated inputs through encoder and MLM head to a contrastive loss.

encoding.shape_means: Cylinder = pre-trained encoder and MLM head; rounded frame with a title set into its border = a data group; double chevrons = step between columns; blue highlighted rectangle = the [Mask] slot; brackets under text = the span they name.

lessons.what_to_learn: Trace the same example sentences from a raw data column through labels and predictions into coloured stratum cards, then carry the stratum colours into the dashed arrows of the training diagram, so one colour code ties data triage to model training.
lessons.suits: Methods with a data-selection or curriculum step followed by a training step, especially NLP few-shot or noisy-label work with text examples.

evidence: The model architecture of HardPT can be divided into two steps.
Samples are classified into easy, hard, and misleading categories by an agent.
The positive sample and negative sample are concatenated behind the hard sample

summary: HardPT is a few-shot prompt-tuning framework that identifies hard samples with a reinforcement-learning agent and learns from them with an adaptive contrastive loss. Figure 1 draws the two steps as stacked panels. In (a), three movie-review sentences are shown with their labels and the model's predictions, coloured green, yellow or red, and two block chevrons lead to dashed cards that sort them into EASY, HARD and MISLEADING. In (b), the EASY and HARD sentences get a cloze template with a [Mask] slot and run through a pre-trained encoder and an MLM head, both drawn as cylinders, in two colour-coded dashed flows that end in the adaptive contrastive loss; the hard sample is joined by rows of orange positive and blue negative samples.
summary_zh: HardPT 图 1 分两步：(a) 把带标签和预测的句子分成 EASY、HARD、MISLEADING 三类；(b) EASY 与 HARD 句子套模板，经编码器和 MLM 头得到自适应对比损失，HARD 另接正负样本。
notes: Prior labels kept (stage-pipeline, worked-walkthrough) and model-anatomy added for panel (b). The RL agent named in the caption is not drawn: the two block chevrons in (a) are the only mark of the processing steps. In the Label column the third label (Positive) differs from its 'Correct label: Neutral' note, so labels are read as the dataset's possibly noisy labels. MISLEADING has no counterpart in (b), as drawn. The colour of the Prediction text follows the caption (green correct, yellow challenging, red incorrect).
